content.value: The [[item/minecraft:anvil|Anvil]] assembles its assigned advanced equipment, including iron, gold, chainmail, diamond and Netherite equipment and tools. Weapon, tool and armour categories keep these groups separate.

Netherite equipment uses [[item/minecraft:netherite_scrap|Netherite Scrap]] directly in its recipes. A helmet uses five scraps and boots use four, following the material counts of the corresponding equipment shapes.
It does not provide vanilla renaming or enchantment combining. Use the [[article/enchantments|Enchanting Table]] for enchantments and the [[article/repairing|Repair Bench]] for repairs.
The current anvil recipe uses one [[item/minecraft:iron_block|Iron Block]] and four [[item/minecraft:iron_ingot|Iron Ingots]].
